name: Local Privilege Escalation
description: This query identifies non-privileged users that can obtain root privileges.

name: Pivot from Dev to Prod
description: This query identifies attack paths from test/dev to prod.

name: Azure Tenant Breakout
description: This query shows non-Azure attack paths from a vm in one Azure tenant to a vm in another tenant.
query:
MATCH (vm1:AZVM)-[:GLH_SameMachine]->(:GLH_SSHComputer)
MATCH (:GLH_SSHComputer)-[:GLH_SameMachine]->(vm2:AZVM)
WHERE vm1.tenantid <> vm2.tenantid
MATCH p=allShortestPaths((vm1)-[*..]->(vm2))
WHERE none(r in relationships(p) WHERE type(r) STARTS WITH "AZ")
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Azure Subscription Breakout
description: This query shows non-Azure attack paths from a vm in one Azure subscription to a vm in another subscription.
query:
MATCH (vm1:AZVM)-[:GLH_SameMachine]->(:GLH_SSHComputer)
MATCH (:GLH_SSHComputer)-[:GLH_SameMachine]->(vm2:AZVM)
WITH 
    vm1,
    vm2,
    substring(vm1.objectid,15,36) AS subscriptionId1,
    substring(vm2.objectid,15,36) AS subscriptionId2
WHERE subscriptionId1 <> subscriptionId2
MATCH p=allShortestPaths((vm1)-[*..]->(vm2))
WHERE none(r in relationships(p) WHERE type(r) STARTS WITH "AZ")
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Azure VMs with Privileged Service Principals
description: This query shows non-Azure attack paths to Azure VMs that have privileges assigned.

name: Active Directory Domain Breakout
description: This query shows non-AD attack paths from an Active Directory principal in one domain to a principal in another domain.
query:
MATCH p1=(u1:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasKeytab|GLH_HasTGT]->(ad1)
MATCH p2=(u2:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasKeytab|GLH_HasTGT]->(ad2)
WHERE u1 <> u2 AND ad1.domain <> ad2.domain
MATCH p=allShortestPaths((u1)-[*..]->(u2))
RETURN p1, p, p2
LIMIT 1000

name: Active Directory Principal Breakout
description: This query shows non-AD attack paths from a user with access to one Active Directory principal to another principal.
query:
MATCH p1=(u1:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasKeytab|GLH_HasTGT]->(ad1)
MATCH p2=(u2:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasKeytab|GLH_HasTGT]->(ad2)
WHERE u1 <> u2 AND ad1 <> ad2
MATCH p=allShortestPaths((u1)-[*..]->(u2))
RETURN p1, p, p2
LIMIT 1000

name: Private Keys on More Than One Computer
description: This query identifies private keys that can be found on multiple hosts.
query:
MATCH (c:GLH_SSHComputer)-[:GLH_CanImpersonate]->(u:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasPrivateKey]->(k:GLH_SSHKeyPair)
WITH k, collect(DISTINCT c) AS computers
WHERE size(computers) > 1
UNWIND computers AS c
MATCH p=(c)-[:GLH_CanImpersonate]->()-[:GLH_HasPrivateKey]->(k)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Unprotected Private Keys
description: This query shows private keys that are unencrypted and not protected by FIDO2.
query:
MATCH p=(:GLH_SSHUser)-[r:GLH_HasPrivateKey]->(k:GLH_SSHKeyPair)
WHERE k.FIDO2 = false AND r.Encrypted = false
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Private Keys with Weak Encryption
description: This query shows non-FIDO2 private keys that are encrypted with something other than aes.
query:
MATCH p=(u:GLH_SSHUser)-[r:GLH_HasPrivateKey]->(k:GLH_SSHKeyPair)
WHERE k.FIDO2 = false
  AND r.Encrypted = true
  AND r.Cipher <> "none"
  AND NOT r.Cipher STARTS WITH "aes256-"
  AND NOT r.Cipher STARTS WITH "aes128-"
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Agent Forwarding
description: This query shows which private keys are forwarded via SSH agent forwarding.

name: Hosts that allow root logins
description: This query returns hosts that allow the root user to login.

name: CA Private Key used for Key-Based Authentication
description: This query surfaces SSH keypairs that are simultaneously trusted as a certificate authority (via `TrustedUserCAKeys` on some host) AND listed as a plain public key in someone's `authorized_keys`. It also shows who has access to the private key, if the information is available.
query:
// find keypairs that are trusted as CA and in authorized keys
MATCH pk = (k:GLH_SSHKeyPair)-[:GLH_CanSSH]->(:GLH_SSHUser)
MATCH pc = (k)-[:GLH_CanIssueCertificate]->(:GLH_SSHUser)
// find out who has the respective private key
OPTIONAL MATCH p0 = (:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasPrivateKey]->(k)
RETURN p0, pk, pc
LIMIT 1000

name: Wildcard Certificates
description: This query returns SSH certificates that authorize login as ANY principal.
query:
MATCH p=(:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasCertificate]->(c:GLH_SSHCertificate)
WHERE c.WildcardPrincipal = true
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Certificates without Expiration Date
description: This query returns SSH certificates that have no expiration date.
query:
MATCH p=(:GLH_SSHUser)-[:GLH_HasCertificate]->(c:GLH_SSHCertificate)
WHERE c.ValidBefore = "9999-12-31T23:59:59Z"
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000

name: Certificate Authentication Paths
description: Show local users holding certificates that authorize authentication as another Linux user, subject to private-key usability and certificate validity.
